notes.title: Death Point Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! In this update we are fix main bugs, improve optimization and change some gameplay features.

 - Fixed Cutscene on Penthouse mission.
 - Fixed crash, that may appear on Engineering Complex mission.
 - A lot of optimization improvements, especially on MacOs and Linux platforms.
 - Saving system: Now checkpoints progress saving even if you quit the game.
 - Load screen show key binds.
 - Full gamepad support!
 - Energy now recharging faster if you stay in locker/box.
 - Blood spots appears only if your health is 50% or lower.
 - Changed background music on Outskirts mission in factory zone.
 - Additional checkpoints on few missions.
